construction_notes.text: City of San Jose permit PRE23-127 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2023), status Complete: "SB330 preliminary application for 213 units"
SF YIMBY (Jul 2023): 113 affordable family units, 64 senior apartments and 36 for-sale affordable townhomes; Core Companies and Eden Housing joint venture.

SF YIMBY (Dec 2023), 675 E Santa Clara St: phase two of the Santa Clara County Housing Authority master plan; 213 affordable units plus two manager units in a seven-story family building, a five-story senior building and 36 for-sale townhomes, with adaptive reuse of historic Building 800 (early IBM office); 190 parking spaces; construction expected to start fall 2025, opening as early as 2027.

Eden Housing: Eden and The Core Companies are master developers of the 2.8-acre East Santa Clara site, led by the Santa Clara County Housing Authority and the County of Santa Clara. Core will develop a 114-unit family building and 36 for-sale BMR townhomes; Eden's 68-unit senior building is at 700 E Saint John St.

County Measure A dashboard: E. Santa Clara Family Apartments, 725 E Santa Clara St, 114 affordable homes including 20 supportive, Eden Housing and The Core Companies, status Pipeline. E. Santa Clara Senior Apartments, 700 E Saint John St, 68 homes, status In Construction.

CEQA Notice of Exemption (May 28, 2025): East Santa Clara Townhomes, 36 affordable for-sale townhomes, applicant The Core Companies, 675 E Santa Clara St, APNs 467-14-087 and 467-14-052, about 3 acres; ministerial under Government Code 65913.4.
